lean_scaffold:
-- IGProtocol scaffold: VINIT → IMSCRIB → AFWD → FSPLIT → EVALF → EVALT → FFUSE → FSPLIT → EVALT → EVALF → ENGAGR → CLINK → AFWD → AREV → EVALT → EVALF → FFUSE → IFIX → TANCH
-- (native ob3ect designer; elaborate against the kernel to verify)
name: A language model whose architecture is the Imscribing Grammar

phase_0.boundary_condition: The kernel's closure verdict (Closed/Identity) that certifies every produced ring as coherent by construction
phase_0.domain_name: A language model whose architecture is the Imscribing Grammar
phase_0.justification: Auto-designed by the native Ob3ect Auto-Designer (in-process candle, no Python)

AFWD.chosen_element: Forward pass through the toroidal architecture (embedding → position → attention → feed-forward → logits)
AFWD.justification: Each layer transforms the ring state toward the denoising target; the circulant walk and content routing advance the ring along its winding

AREV.chosen_element: Backward pass propagating gradients through the ring-bias, content routing, and ENGAGR projections
AREV.justification: Gradients descend the toroidal topology, updating the learnable per-head ring widths and the fork/fuse projections under the μ∘δ orthogonality penalty

CLINK.chosen_element: Sequential chaining of attention block and feed-forward block within each layer
CLINK.justification: The output of the fused attention arms feeds directly into the ENGAGR feed-forward, whose fused output becomes the next layer's input — a strict morphism chain

ENGAGR.chosen_element: Feed-forward block that holds T-arm and F-arm simultaneously without collapsing either, outputting fuse(T ⊗ σ(F))
ENGAGR.justification: This is the dialectic core: the two arms are not alternatives but co-present. The T-arm passes linearly; the F-arm passes through sigmoid; their product is the fused result — a live contradiction held as computation

EVALF.chosen_element: Circulant-bias arm in attention; F-arm (negative projection) in ENGAGR feed-forward
EVALF.justification: The constructive falsity arm carries the fixed toroidal topology — the circulant ring bias that gives every position identical neighbourhood structure

EVALT.chosen_element: Content-routing arm in attention; T-arm (affirmative projection) in ENGAGR feed-forward
EVALT.justification: The constructive truth arm carries learned content dependence — queries and keys that route information around the ring based on token identity

FFUSE.chosen_element: Attention fuse: circulant output ⊕ content output fused by learned per-head gate; feed-forward fuse: T ⊗ σ(F) fused into single post-activation
FFUSE.justification: The μ projections rejoin the arms: attention uses a switchable bidirectional/causal gate; feed-forward multiplies T-arm by sigmoid of F-arm. Both fuses are driven toward μ∘δ = id by the orthogonality penalty

FSPLIT.chosen_element: Attention fork: the ring state splits into circulant-bias arm and content-routing arm; feed-forward fork: the pre-activation splits into T-arm and F-arm
FSPLIT.justification: Two distinct forks exist: (1) attention δ projects the ring into a circulant walk (fixed ring topology) and a content-dependent routing (learned queries/keys); (2) ENGAGR δ projects into affirmative (T) and negative (F) arms held simultaneously

IFIX.chosen_element: Baked M2TO f32 blob and the kernel verdict log appended per training step
IFIX.justification: The metal port flattens the trunk to a no_std scalar forward (torus.rs) with bit-exact parity; the kernel verdict count (Closed/Identity rings) is an irreversible record of coherence

IMSCRIB.chosen_element: Each token's crystal_coord — its 12-axis coordinate indexed by the twelve marks in canonical order
IMSCRIB.justification: The vocabulary IS the ontology; a token does not map to an embedding, it IS its coordinate. Self-recognition is literal: the mark ⊢ occupies axis 0, ⊣ axis 1, and so on

TANCH.chosen_element: Kernel-certified closed ring bearing the Closed/Identity verdict
TANCH.justification: The terminal anchor is not a token but the kernel's own voice: imasm_core::word_verdict returns Closed/Identity, sealing the ring as a valid IMASM word

VINIT.chosen_element: Uninitialized model state before any ring is presented
VINIT.justification: The model begins as a void trunk with randomly seeded crystal coordinates and zeroed ring-bias parameters, awaiting the first masked ring

phase_2.fuse_element: Dual fuse: attention μ (gated sum) and ENGAGR μ (T ⊗ σ(F))
phase_2.fuse_result: Single ring state advanced one layer: attention-fused neighbourhood context → ENGAGR-fused non-linearity
phase_2.rejoin_note: Both forks close: attention arms rejoin via switchable bidirectional/causal gate; feed-forward arms rejoin via multiplicative fusion. The μ∘δ orthogonality penalty drives each fork toward identity on the ring topology. The kernel verdict gate evaluates the final fused ring.
phase_2.split_element: Dual fork: attention δ (circulant ⊕ content) and ENGAGR δ (T ⊕ F)
phase_2.split_input: Ring state at each layer: crystal_coord sequence with ring_winding position
split_outputs: Attention: circulant-bias arm (fixed ring topology) and content-routing arm (learned queries/keys)
Feed-forward: T-arm (affirmative linear projection) and F-arm (negative sigmoid projection)
phase_2.verdict_reason: Tri-ancestral reconnection over a transformed object — closes

phase_3.both_description: B4 B (11) — ENGAGR holding T ⊗ σ(F) live; attention fusing circulant ⊕ content; kernel verdict Closed/Identity certifying the ring as a valid IMASM word
phase_3.false_description: B4 F (10) — circulant-bias arm active: fixed toroidal topology provides neighbourhood structure independent of content
phase_3.true_description: B4 T (01) — content-routing arm active: learned queries/keys successfully route signal around the ring
phase_3.void_description: B4 N (00) — uninitialized trunk: random crystal_coord seeds, zero ring-bias, no rings presented

steps.domain_action: trunk allocated with random crystal_coord seeds and zeroed per-head ring-bias parameters
each vocabulary mark ⊢ ⊣ ≻ ≺ ⋈ ⊙ ∈ ∋ ⊤ ⊥ ⊞ ⊡ claims its canonical axis in the 12-d crystal_coord
masked ring enters — crystal_coord sequence with ring_winding position (no rope, pure toroidal index)
attention δ forks ring state into circulant-bias arm (fixed circulant kernel) and content-routing arm (Q/K projections)
circulant-bias arm walks the ring — every position sees identical neighbourhood via learnable per-head width
content-routing arm computes queries and keys from crystal_coord, routing signal by token identity
attention μ fuses arms via switchable bidirectional/causal gate — output is neighbourhood context fused with content
ENGAGR δ forks fused attention output into T-arm (linear) and F-arm (sigmoid) projections
T-arm passes affirmative projection linearly — constructive truth held open
F-arm passes negative projection through sigmoid — constructive falsity held open
both arms held simultaneously — output = fuse(T ⊗ σ(F)) — dialectic non-linearity without collapse
fused ENGAGR output chains into next layer's attention input — strict morphism composition
repeat attention → ENGAGR for each layer — ring state advances along its winding
loss gradients descend — ring-bias widths updated, Q/K projections updated, ENGAGR projections updated under μ∘δ orthogonality penalty
kernel verdict gate (imasm_core::word_verdict) evaluates final ring — touches constructive truth (Closed/Identity)
denoising loss evaluates masked positions — touches constructive falsity (reconstruction error)
training step fuses kernel verdict (coherence) and denoising loss (accuracy) into single update signal
baked M2TO blob written — bit-exact no_std trunk for metal port; kernel verdict count appended to log
kernel returns Closed/Identity — ring sealed as valid IMASM word, boundary confirmed

phase_5.alfs_store: imasm_core crate — the canonical IMASM ontology (12 marks, crystal_coord indexing, word_verdict function, SIXTEEN_3 semantics)
phase_5.compiler_frontend: Rust/candle toolchain — translates IMASM ontology into native tensor operations; crate imasm_core provides the 12-axis alphabet and word_verdict kernel
phase_5.ipc_mechanism: Tensor passing between attention blocks, ENGAGR blocks, and the kernel verdict gate — all in-memory safetensors during training, M2TO blob for metal
phase_5.memory_mechanism: safetensors checkpoint for host trunk; M2TO f32 blob (flat, no_std) for metal port; kernel verdict log as append-only record
phase_5.scheduler_mechanism: Fixed-step CPU training loop (2000 steps in Phase 3); each step: sample masked ring → forward → kernel verdict + denoising loss → backward → update

phase_6.cycle_cost: One forward-backward pass per masked ring (1502 structured rings, 1352/150 split); compute dominated by circulant attention O(L²) and ENGAGR projections
phase_6.delta_s_verdict: ΔS ≈ 0 — the μ∘δ = id penalty conserves the ring topology (identity on SIXTEEN_3); learning only refines content routing within the fixed toroidal manifold
phase_6.post_cycle_state: Trained trunk: refined crystal_coord, learned ring-bias widths, μ∘δ penalty driven to zero, kernel verdict rate 14.0% (9/64 val rings Closed/Identity)
phase_6.pre_cycle_state: Untrained trunk: random crystal_coord, zero ring-bias, μ∘δ penalty high, kernel verdict rate near chance (8.3%)
